description: Demonstration questions for the SYNTHETIC EBC HLD sample, with the evidence a correct answer must cite. Page numbers refer to the generated PDFs. Used by docs/user_guide.md; the retrieval tests check a subset automatically.

revision_A.question: What are the major software components described in this document?
revision_A.expected_evidence: Table 4-1 (page 2): WheelSpeedProcessor, VehicleStateEstimator, BrakeTorqueCoordinator, BrakeActuatorManager, DiagnosticEventHandler, HmiWarningManager

revision_A.question: What is the unit and range of Sig_VehicleSpeed?
Which interfaces or signals are associated with the VehicleStateEstimator?
revision_A.expected_evidence: Port table (page 3): RP_WheelSpeed / IF_WheelSpeed (required), PP_VehicleState / IF_VehicleState (provided); signals table (page 4)

revision_A.question: Summarize the functional flow for wheel slip control.
Which sections mention Sig_YawRate?
revision_A.expected_evidence: Only section 4.2 VehicleStateEstimator (page 2). Use 'Find every mention of a term' for an exact answer.

revision_A.question: What is the ASIL rating of the BrakeTorqueCoordinator?
revision_A.expected_evidence: Not in the document — the correct behaviour is an 'insufficient evidence' response.

revision_B.question: How does degraded mode handling work?
revision_B.expected_evidence: Section 9 Degraded Mode Handling (page 5) — exists only in revision B

intentional_issues_revision_A: Duplicate component identifier C-05 (DiagnosticEventHandler and HmiWarningManager)
HmiWarningManager has no description and no ports
Port PP_ActuatorStatus references IF_ActuatorStatus, which is not defined
BrakeTorqueCoordinator depends on PedalInputHandler, which is not defined
Sig_YawRate and Sig_BrakePedalPosition are mentioned but not in the signal table
VehicleStateEstimator is described differently in Table 4-1 and in Appendix A
intentional_changes_A_to_B: Component added: PedalInputHandler (C-06); component removed: HmiWarningManager
Interfaces added: IF_ActuatorStatus, IF_PedalRequest; ports added: PP_PedalRequest, RP_PedalRequest
Sig_VehicleSpeed changed from float32 km/h (0..300) to uint16 0.01 km/h (0..30000)
Sig_BrakeTorqueRequest range changed to 0..6000 Nm and a consumer was added
Section 9 Degraded Mode Handling added; FF-01 flow updated
